# Binod Nagarkoti - Portfolio

> Binod Nagarkoti is a full-stack software engineer specializing in modern web applications, Next.js, React, Node.js, Firebase, and Supabase. This application serves as a central hub for his professional portfolio, technical blogs, and project showcases.
